title: 출국대기실 운영 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:8:0:00008:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 8 (Safety Measures)
(1) Where an emergency such as a natural disaster or fire occurs, the head, etc. shall promptly evacuate admitted foreigners to a temporary evacuation facility designated at the port of entry or departure.
(2) Where there is no temporary evacuation facility under paragraph (1), or such facility is deemed unsafe, the head, etc. shall move admitted foreigners to a safe place outside the departure waiting room. In such cases, cooperation necessary for their safety may be requested from relevant agencies.
(3) The head, etc. may install, within budgetary limits, equipment such as video information processing devices necessary for safety measures.
(4) Except as provided in paragraphs (1) through (3), Articles 37 (3) through (5) of the Rules on Protection of Foreigners shall apply mutatis mutandis to safety measures for admitted foreigners. In such cases, "protected foreigner" shall be deemed "admitted foreigner," and "protection facility" shall be deemed "departure waiting room."
